_comment: Configurable decision-support thresholds; NOT biologically validated thresholds. These define risk tiers over the frozen model's raw onset SCORE (0-1), which calibration testing (calibration_assessment.json) found is not a calibrated probability. Edit these values to change risk-tier behavior -- never hardcode thresholds in the dashboard code.
score_display_mode_reason: calibration_assessment.json: expected_calibration_error=0.478, non-monotonic reliability curve -- fails the pre-set 0.10 tolerance. Display as 'predicted onset score', not a percentage probability.

risk_thresholds._meaning: score < low_max => LOW; low_max <= score <= moderate_max => MODERATE; score > moderate_max => HIGH

early_warning_messages.LOW: Low predicted onset risk; routine monitoring is recommended.
early_warning_messages.MODERATE: Moderate likelihood of observed locust-report onset; increased monitoring is recommended.
early_warning_messages.HIGH: Elevated likelihood of observed locust-report onset during the forecast period.

recommendation_rules.HIGH: Prioritize field surveillance and monitoring in the affected region
